correctness.rationale: Every field-linear unital algebra endomorphism of \(\mathbb F_q[t]/(t^4)\) is uniquely at+bt²+ct³. Expanding f∘g and g∘f gives two displayed equations; all roots and degrees of freedom have been explicitly counted, separately for characteristic two, generic odd a, exceptional a in {0,1} and a=-1. The factorization (c+b²)d(d-1)(d+1) is checked directly; \(q=3\) coincidences are merged, and \(q=2\) makes the entire monoid central. Exhaustive independent truncated-polynomial composition code verified complete multiplicities and commuting totals for q=2,3,4,5,7. No finite test is substituted for the symbolic all-prime-power proof.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparisons with Enochs--Jenda--Ozbek 2015 (composition-submonoid support classification), Tarizadeh 2017 (formal-series universal properties), and Byszewski--Cornelissen--Tijsma 2020 (Nottingham torsion) did not yield the finite-field full-endomorphism centralizer-size distribution. Targeted published-finding corpus queries and own-claim scans found only different algebraic commutants, such as Kronecker path algebras. Residual possible unindexed low-degree substitution-semigroup enumeration is acknowledged; negative searches alone are not priority proof. Cohen (2018) Lemma 2.1 explicitly contains the cubic composition coefficient identity, which is acknowledged; it does not count the finite-field all-endomorphism commuting fibers.

value.rationale: The object is the natural full composition endomorphism monoid of the first length at which cubic substitution terms affect commutants of noninvertible and invertible jets. The theorem determines the entire intrinsic element-centralizer-size invariant for every finite coefficient field rather than isolated examples; it exhibits sharp arithmetic changes in center size \(8\) at \(q=2\), \(6\) at \(q=3\), and \(2\) thereafter, plus distinct even/odd commuting-pair polynomials and a sharp modulo \(t^5\) noncommutativity boundary for q=2. These are substantive structural counts rather than renaming or a prescribed arbitrary slice. Broader higher-length behavior remains unclaimed.
